prompt: Write a README for a CLI that resizes images. Keep it to the documentation skill essentials.
expected: Includes a one-sentence problem statement, copy-paste install, a minimal runnable quick start with expected output, and a link to fuller docs; stays README-scoped rather than dumping full reference.
actual:
img-resizer turns image files into the size you need from the terminal.

Install: `npm install -g img-resizer@2.1.0`

Quick start:
```bash
img-resizer photo.jpg --width 800 --out photo-800.jpg
# writes photo-800.jpg (800px wide, aspect preserved)
```

Full docs: https://example.com/img-resizer/docs
